rows.grounds: Qualifies the foot or side being described; taken as the right one in this iconographic context.
Compound indicating the end or upper part of the left leg/thigh as the locus.
Describes the right element as raised or emerging; surface form taken as given without splitting.
Compound denoting the left foot, completing the description of placement.

items.question: Where is the right foot positioned in relation to the left leg in this iconographic description?
premises: The right element is described as risen up.
Its position is specified at the end of the left leg.
The left foot is explicitly named in the same description.
items.inference: The iconographic form places the right foot raised at the upper part of the left leg in relation to the left foot.
uncertainties: The exact anatomical referent of vāmajaṅghānta (thigh, knee, or shank end) is context-dependent.
The surface form mudbhutaṃ may reflect an unresolved fusion or orthographic variant of udbhutaṃ/samudbhutaṃ.
items.plain_english: The right foot is raised up at the end of the left leg, by the left foot.
